min.description: Completed entries into the selected destination. Staying inside or reconnecting inside does not add a visit. Age bounds measure server ticks, 20 per second.

settlement.description: Current means the speaker's settlement, the saved quest issuer's settlement, or your current settlement for player-only checks. Any matches all recorded settlements. Use id to select a durable settlement UUID.

min.description: Completed entries into the selected destination. Staying inside or reconnecting inside does not add a visit. Age bounds measure server ticks, 20 per second.

destination.description: Count distinct structure instances, registered structure types, or canonical settlements. Instances use dimension and start chunk. Settlement merges combine identities. Optional structures filters structure counts.

items.description: Item types observed in your inventory, equipment or cursor remain known after loss. Unopened containers and recipe previews do not establish possession.

min_age_ticks.description: Elapsed server game ticks, 20 per second. Bounds apply to the first or most recent occurrence, not a rolling event count.

max_age_ticks.description: Elapsed server game ticks, 20 per second. Bounds apply to the first or most recent occurrence, not a rolling event count.

player_only.description: Only this player's events. Defaults to false for world scope, true otherwise.

need.description: Supply needs measure missing units after committed and incoming supplies. Food uses nutrition points, other supplies use their demand quantities. Housing counts residents without a usable assigned bed. Workers counts unfilled desired worksite positions. Unavailable observations remain unknown.

target.description: Registered block, item, entity or custom statistic. Values use vanilla units: distance in centimetres, time in ticks, damage in tenths of a health point. Workstation statistics count interactions.

then.description: Checks a campaign role and its saved replacements without casting or spawning.
Checks whether a bound, loaded campaign character is nearby and actively recruited into the player's party without casting or spawning.
Checks a player's distance from an already-bound campaign destination.

operation_id.description: A stable ID. Ordinary dialogue executes once per player. Quest actions execute once per quest run. Keep this ID when editing or moving the action.

direction.description: Give player: the player receives newly supplied items. Take player: the player gives items. Armor and offhand slots are never removed by random selection.

selection.description: Specific: choose one item. Pool: choose an eligible configured entry. Random inventory: choose an eligible item from the player's main inventory.

quantity.description: Total items to give or take. This overrides the authored stack's default count.

matching.description: Item compares the base type. Components compares all item components. Quest-item references always require their separate quest identity.

destination.description: Consume removes taken items. Villager places them in the receiving villager's inventory.

on_missing.description: Fail blocks the action and preserves the chosen item for retry. Skip permanently completes this operation without transferring items.

on_full.description: Fail blocks the action and preserves the chosen item for retry. Skip permanently completes this operation without transferring items.

orientation.description: Explicit Minecraft yaw and pitch in degrees. Relative placement stores yaw relative to the player-to-speaker direction. Fixed placement stores world yaw.

position.description: Optional absolute world position for fixed placement. Runtime distance and geometry limits still apply.

focus.description: Track a body slot, including an empty hand or armor slot.

match.description: Exact item or block registry ID.

marker.description: Unique marker entity tag within 32 blocks of the origin.

offset.description: Block offset in world axes from the resolved origin.

radius.description: Find exactly one match in this block radius. Zero checks the origin block only.

entity_tag.description: Additional tag required on a dropped item.
